title: Regime Shift
briefing: Three specialists, three styles: Momentum Max, Value Vera and Breakout Bea. The market will change character twice. Whoever adapts wins.
objective: Identify the regime and switch strategy: trend, then chop, then breakdown, plus one real breakout.
debrief: Nimbus Cloud trended for two weeks, then chopped from day 14 with two partnership rumors that faded (days 17 and 23), then broke down after losing a major client on day 29. Each specialist won one phase and gave it back in the others. Meanwhile Kestrel Air drifted lower in a quiet base until its national contract on day 30 sent it out on heavy volume. A disciplined player rode the early trend, cut exposure in the chop, was in cash for the breakdown and caught the confirmed Kestrel Air breakout.

news.headline: Nimbus Cloud shares pop on partnership chatter
news.body: Unconfirmed reports say a large software firm may partner with Nimbus.

news.headline: Nimbus Cloud partnership talk remains unconfirmed
news.body: Neither company has commented on the reports.

news.headline: New report revives Nimbus Cloud partnership talk
news.body: A trade blog repeats the claim, again without a named source.

news.headline: Software firm says it has no plans to partner with Nimbus
news.body: The firm says it is building its own cloud service.

news.headline: Nimbus Cloud loses a major client to a rival
news.body: The client made up about 6% of Nimbus's sales.

news.headline: Kestrel Air wins the national carrier contract for regional routes
news.body: The ten-year deal guarantees government business on 20 routes.

basic.text: Finish first, ahead of Momentum Max, Value Vera and Breakout Bea

bonus.text: Make no new buys during the chop (days 15 to 27)
Be out of Nimbus Cloud by day 31, after the lower low
Buy Kestrel Air within 2 days of its high-volume breakout
